news_items.headline: GPGI Reports First Quarter 2026 Results
news_items.summary: Q1 2026 pro forma adjusted net sales of $421.2M (+3% YoY) and pro forma adjusted EBITDA of $82.1M (-16% YoY, 19.5% margin). GAAP net loss of $235M. Maintains 2026 guide of $1.95B-$2.1B pro forma sales and $550M-$610M EBITDA.

news_items.headline: GPGI Q1 pro forma sales rise 3%, EBITDA falls 16%
news_items.summary: Mixed quarter: CompoSecure delivered record ROS-driven performance; Husky hit by sharp oil and resin price volatility and ongoing tariff uncertainty, driving the EBITDA decline.

news_items.headline: GPGI (NYSE:GPGI) Plunges 12.7% Pre-Market After Q1 Earnings Miss
news_items.summary: Shares fell roughly 12.7% in pre-market trading following the Q1 print. Total post-earnings decline reported at 25.52%, reflecting strong negative market reaction to the EBITDA miss and GAAP loss.

news_items.headline: GPGI Posts Mixed Q1 2026 Results, Maintains Outlook
news_items.summary: Company maintains full-year 2026 guidance for higher sales, earnings and cash flow despite Q1 miss; emphasized accelerated ROS (Resolute Operating System) deployment across portfolio.

news_items.headline: GPGI is Down 18.5% After Revenue Collapse And Rising Losses Reveal Shifting Investment Narrative
news_items.summary: Coverage frames the post-earnings decline as a narrative shift driven by revenue weakness and rising losses, with Husky tariff/commodity exposure as the principal drag.

news_items.headline: GPGI Board Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend of $0.0025
news_items.summary: Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.0025 per Class A share on May 6, 2026, payable June 1, 2026 to shareholders of record on May 18, 2026.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: No analyst-rating changes in last 7 days surfaced. Pre-print consensus: Buy with PTs ranging $22-$26 (5-analyst average $26.20); TipRanks AI (Spark) rates Neutral. Ratings predate the May 7 Q1 miss and may be revised downward in coming days.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 already reported May 7, 2026 — EBITDA miss (-16% YoY) and $235M GAAP loss; full-year guide reaffirmed at $1.95B-$2.1B pro forma sales and $550M-$610M EBITDA. Forward catalysts: stabilizing revenue growth, Husky operational fixes (oil/resin/tariffs), continued ROS deployment. Next earnings date not formally announced; Q2 2026 typically reports early August.
